text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - canary-deploy-frontend
incident-bot: page fired -> high 5xx rate from canary group (service: text-gen, route: /v1/generate) :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Triggering PagerDuty incident PD#98321 -> escalation to #oncall (primary)

maria: acked oncall-bot :thumbsup: I'm on it, pulling logs now

sre_jordan: thanks. quick check — did rollout push last night? Li did a canary ramp to 10% around 03:10 UTC

deploy_engineer_li: yep — small canary (10%). No config changes other than model variant switch to q4f for inference perf testing

maria: seeing 5xx spikes in the canary hosts only. p50/p95 fine overall, but p99 token generation failing with model decode errors. sample log: ```
2026-03-15T03:22:17Z error decode_step failed: kvcache-mismatch on shard-3
2026-03-15T03:22:17Z warn fallback -> model-variant q4f-experimental returned 500 for req id=abc123
```

ops_maya: copying k8s pods in canary namespace: `kubectl get pods -n text-gen-canary` shows 3/5 restarting on node gpu-12

pm_tom: any customer-facing impact? metrics?

maria: prelim telemetry: ~0.8% of total requests hit the canary group (intended), but within that group 22% of requests are 5xx during the spike window -> overall ~0.17% of total requests affected. small but noisy on monitoring dashboards.

sre_jordan: thanks. plan: 1) divert traffic off canary (set weight=0) 2) rollback canary to previous model variant 3) watch error rate/latency 4) if stable, roll forward with fix. agree?

deploy_engineer_li: agree. initiating traffic diversion now. command: ```
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --service text-gen --target canary --weight 0 --reason "emergency divert due to 5xx spike"
```

on-technical-bot: Checkout link -> https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/text-gen/2243

pagerduty-bot: PD#98321 updated: acknowledged by maria at 03:24 UTC

maria: diversion applied. canary weight is 0. monitoring...

ops_maya: removing pods from node gpu-12 temporarily to break noisy host: `kubectl cordon gpu-12` then `kubectl delete pod <pod>` to force reschedule

deploy_engineer_li: starting rollback to previous model-variant (q4f-stable). running rollout command: ```
redwoodctl model rollback --service text-gen --from-variant q4f-experimental --to-variant q4f-stable --canary-only
```

maria: rollback triggered. logs show new pods come up with q4f-stable. initial requests returning 200s

sre_jordan: monitoring metrics: canary 5xx dropped from 22% -> 1.6% within 2 minutes of rollback. overall system healthy. still watching p99 latency for potential regressions.

pm_tom: customer note: two small customers reported degraded completions for ~5-7 minutes. Ops to follow up by EOD.

maria: creating follow-up ticket: "CANARY-98321: q4f-experimental -> decode errors, canary rollback performed, impact: minor" will include logs and sample request ids.

deploy_engineer_li: adding config diff: the experimental variant used a custom KV cache size + different kernel selection. suspect kvcache sizing issue on certain shard assignments.

sre_jordan: good. next steps: 1) collect pod metrics for gpu memory / kvcache evictions 2) reproduce in staging with same shard placement 3) add automatic canary-safety check to block experimental q4f if kvcache mismatch errors > 1%

maria: pinging infra to help repro: @ops_maya can you snapshot the node gpu-12 logs and the crashed pods?

ops_maya: grabbing logs now, attaching S3 link when done: s3://redwood-incident-logs/98321/gpu-12-03-15.tar.gz

pagerduty-bot: PD#98321 -> status: resolved by maria at 03:31 UTC (incident closed).

maria: closing thread here, leaving postmortem ticket and handoff to morning oncall for follow-up. key quick notes:
- cause: model-variant q4f-experimental triggered kvcache-decode errors on some shard placements
- impact: ~0.17% total requests affected, two customers reported brief degradation
- mitigation: divert canary traffic -> rollback to q4f-stable -> cordon/reschedule noisy node
- next actions: reproduce, add safety gate on rollout, add extra kvcache telemetry for variant installs

pm_tom: thanks team. I'll draft a short customer-facing note for impacted accounts and loop in cs.

sre_jordan: handing off longform postmortem to next oncall @maria (or next morning). created follow-up ticket ID TKT-1456 in backlog.

maria: handing off to morning: pls pick up TKT-1456, review logs in S3, and confirm fix in staging before re-promoting q4f-experimental.

on-technical-bot: Follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-1456

maria: thanks all. closing. :white_check_mark:
